case.summary: Verdict: uncertain. A single online transaction (txn 3478782) on card C11891-K1 for $292.36 on 2016-11-22 is flagged as possible card-not-present fraud — the amount is well above the customer's historical mean of $43.99, and the customer has a prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4160) on the same card. However, the evidence is a single signal (fraud probability 0.58, below the 0.70 threshold), with no device, region, or shared-email anomalies, so the pattern is not confirmed. Recommended action per R1: VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER (or STEP_UP_AUTH) before any block, with MONITOR_CARD on C11891-K1 in the interim.
